name: ET 4640 (Multi-Function Meter)
subtitle: Industrial - Energy Meter
description: A panel-mountable three-phase multi-function energy meter tracking voltage, current, power, energy, and power factor across all phases with CT programmability, onboard RTC, and data storage.

hardware.value: Phase-wise LL, LN, max and min values
L1, L2, L3 — max & min values and neutral current

use_cases.title: Energy Consumption Monitoring
use_cases.desc: Tracks real-time power consumption across connected devices and network infrastructure, providing visibility into energy usage patterns. This helps identify inefficiencies, optimize power utilization, and make informed decisions to reduce operational costs.

use_cases.title: Industrial Power Quality Analysis
use_cases.desc: Monitors key electrical parameters such as voltage, current, frequency, and power factor to assess the quality and stability of the power supply. It helps detect abnormalities, prevent equipment damage, and maintain reliable industrial operations.

use_cases.title: Utility & Compliance Metering
use_cases.desc: Enables accurate measurement and recording of electrical parameters to support utility monitoring, energy reporting, and regulatory compliance. It provides reliable consumption data and helps organizations maintain transparency in energy usage and meet applicable standards.
